observations.reading: Blind reading matches actual-recipient-only inclusion and disjoint input/other-output/reasoning decomposition. Caption and table both retain provider-reported zero reasoning for plain recipients. Bar totals and one-million scale match table accounting identities.
observations.annotation_burden: Stacked bars directly retain absolute totals and disjoint accounting composition; alternate normalised shares would answer a different question and lose the total-token reduction context.
observations.reproduction: Three component boundaries and consistent left-to-right order survive greyscale. Input and reasoning have similar tones but the fixed stack order and caption preserve identity. Ordinary-versus-EAL row labels remain explicit.

initial_reconstruction.claim: Recipient-only total token use is lower under EAL in each actual recipient-model/tool group. Much of the reduction is in input tokens. The reasoning-model groups also contain provider-reported reasoning output; plain-model groups show a reported zero reasoning component.
quantities: Horizontal stacked lengths are summed recipient tokens in millions, from zero. Gray is input including cached input; blue is other output; orange is provider-reported reasoning output. Other output is output minus reasoning, so stacked endpoints equal input plus output.

Gray, blue and orange legend boxes match visible stacked components. Plain rows have no orange component, as explained by a reported zero in the caption. The header and caption both scope the legend to recipient sessions only.
initial_reconstruction.evidence_status: Observed token-accounting aggregates with a derived disjoint decomposition. Zero plain reasoning is provider-reported accounting and does not itself demonstrate absence of internal reasoning. No uncertainty estimate is shown.
initial_reconstruction.scope: 480 recipient sessions in each actual recipient-model/tool/arm group from 48 trajectories. Donors are excluded; eight rows separate EAL E and ordinary O within four groups. These are totals rather than per-session averages or shares.
unintended_inferences: Composition and absolute totals may be compared across equal-sized recipient groups. The plot cannot show donor composition or convert tokens into monetary, energy or compute costs. It does not identify causal effects of native-tool permission.
